operator_text.quote: DESY is a research centre of the Helmholtz Association ... a publicly funded national research centre, financed 90% on the national level (German Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space); 10% on the state level (City of Hamburg and Federal State of Brandenburg).
operator_text.value: A publicly funded German national research centre, member of the Helmholtz Association, financed 90% by the German Federal Ministry of Research and 10% by the City of Hamburg and the Federal State of Brandenburg

summary.plain: Germany's national laboratory for particle and accelerator physics, in Hamburg. Its HERA ring was the world's only electron-proton collider, and DESY continues to build and run major accelerator-based research facilities.
summary.technical: German Helmholtz-Association national research centre (Hamburg-Bahrenfeld, with a second site at Zeuthen), founded 18 December 1959; built and operated the HERA electron/positron-proton collider (1992-2007) with the H1 and ZEUS experiments.
